pagetitle: "Peekbank | About"
title: "About this site"
---

This site provides interactive visualizations of the
[Peekbank](https://peekbank.github.io/peekbank-website/) database, an open
repository of developmental eye-tracking data from looking-while-listening
studies of children's word recognition.

All plots are computed in your browser from compact per-dataset extracts of
the current database release, which is versioned and hosted on
[Redivis](https://redivis.com/datapages/datasets/peekbank). For full data
access use the [peekbankr](https://github.com/peekbank/peekbankr) R package,
query the dataset directly on Redivis, or see the
[data access documentation](https://peekbank.github.io/peekbank-website/start/dataaccess/).

## Citation

If you use Peekbank data, please cite the database paper and the original
publications for each dataset you use (listed on the
[Datasets](datasets.html) page):

> Zettersten, M., Yurovsky, D., Xu, T. L., Uner, S., Tsui, A. S. M.,
> Schneider, R. M., Saleh, A. N., Meylan, S. C., Marchman, V. A.,
> Mankewitz, J., MacDonald, K., Long, B., Lewis, M., Kachergis, G.,
> Handa, K., deMayo, B., Carstensen, A., Braginsky, M., Boyce, V.,
> Bhatt, N. S., Bergey, C. A., & Frank, M. C. (2023). Peekbank: An open,
> large-scale repository for developmental eye-tracking data of children's
> word recognition. *Behavior Research Methods*, 55(5), 2485–2500.
> [doi:10.3758/s13428-022-01906-4](https://doi.org/10.3758/s13428-022-01906-4)

## The analyses

The visualizations follow standard analysis conventions for
looking-while-listening data (Fernald, Zangl, Portillo, & Marchman, 2008):
proportion target looking among target-and-distractor looks; landing-time
reaction times on distractor-initial trials; onset-contingent looking
curves. Trials excluded by the contributing labs are included by default
(Peekbank archives all contributed data), and can be filtered with the
"Include lab-excluded trials" toggle.

Built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and
[Observable](https://observablehq.com/plot/); source at
[peekbank/peekbank-datapage](https://github.com/peekbank/peekbank-datapage).
